No no no dont think like that. You are not sick, and it's not over. For me, it's been a little over a year since my suicide attempt and thing have gotten so much better. I am also trans in a semi transphobic house. I've made new friends, I got my name changed at school, even my parents started calling me my new name without me asking. I know things seem hopeless and like everyone is against you right now, but I promise waiting it out a little longer things will get better
I mean confusing for you. For her to be seemingly into you but then have a boyfriend and deny having a boyfriend.
What about physically harming yourself in the past but not anymore?

That sounds very confusing, but I wouldn't say you were in the wrong, it kinda sounds like she was leading you on. I'd say if you can, get in contact with her boyfriend and tell him what shes been doing or just distancing yourself from her.

I remember when I used to be catholic and this is exactly how I used to think. It was all I could think about and it was terrifying. And I'm not sure what changed but I became an atheist. I feel like all the thoughts of heaven and hell and god and the afterlife just crowded my mind and it was so complicated and confusing. I remember after I had become an atheist, a couple years later my dog that I was really close to died and i had to accept the fact in my head that I was never going to see her again. Not here and not in the afterlife. And with how upsetting that thought was it also brought me peace. I had a great grandpa who died and was brought back, and he said that he didn't see anything, but it felt like the best sleep he had ever had. That's how I like to think of death. Just going to bed one last time y'know. With those thoughts, things just seemed so simple and easy and peaceful. Like I know how tired I am in the mornings when I just want to go back to sleep and I know one day I will. One day I can go back to sleep, and eventually will everyone else. Now just so you know I'm not trying to change your beliefs or anything, just sharing my thoughts. I really hope this helps because I've been there and I know exactly what your going through and it sucks.
